description: This script creates a tar archive for Linksys switches' firmware images, including functions to generate image checks, upgrade scripts for NOR and NAND flash, and packaging of related files into a tar archive.

methods.name: gen_imagecheck
methods.description: Generates a shell script to check if the image matches the hardware model.

methods.name: gen_fwinfo
methods.description: Outputs firmware version and boot version information.

methods.name: gen_nor_upgrade
methods.description: Creates a shell script to upgrade firmware in NOR flash.

methods.name: gen_nand_upgrade
methods.description: Creates a shell script to upgrade firmware in NAND flash.
